other_conditions: Artist must be popular and famous
Artist must have professionally rendered services for the enrichment of traditional arts
Artist’s work must show lasting contribution, popularity, and merit in the relevant art discipline
Award can be conferred for only one discipline per artist
Joint award possible if more than one artist is jointly engaged in artistic pursuit
Individual works of art or a single achievement are not considered for the award
benefits_summary: The award includes an investiture gold pendant of three sovereign ponnadai and a citation.
